articles.summary: DENVER, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - National Bank Holdings Corporation (NYSE: NBHC) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend to shareholders. The cash dividend of thirty-three cents ($0.33) per share of NBHC common stock will be payable on December 15, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 27, 2026. “We are pleased to announce an increase to our quarterly dividend, reinforcing our commitment to delivering attractive shareholder returns. We maintain a strong balance sheet, solid capital position, and diversified funding, which continue to drive meaningful returns for our shareholders,” said Chairman, President and CEO, Tim Laney. About National Bank Holdings Corporation National Bank Holdings Corporation is a bank holding company created to build a leading community bank franchise, delivering high quality client service and committed to stakeholder results.
